main.instructions: Run both independent audit nodes concurrently using the official task controls and their supplied assignments. Require real per-task Git commits, PRs and integrations, inspect both reports and integrate the group result before formal completion. Do not call a group finished after only one branch succeeds. Preserve imported source files and workflow.json.

code_audit.instructions: Independently review the imported project's code without editing it. Write only audits/code.md with concrete evidence, risks and test gaps. Use the task-scoped Git tools to commit, create/merge the permitted PR, then finish_task. Do not edit another audit's path or claim unexecuted tests.

contract_audit.instructions: Independently review the imported project's documented interfaces and acceptance requirements. Write only audits/contract.md with concrete evidence and discrepancies. Use task-scoped Git tools to commit, create/merge the permitted PR, then finish_task. Preserve all source files and the other audit's paths.

decisionPlans.audit: Require both independent audits and an integrated group result. Report defects honestly; an audit task may complete with documented risks, not fabricated repairs.

termination.condition: Both audit reports exist in the integrated project and Main has inspected their concrete evidence and disclosed remaining risks.
